artifacts.summary: 12-phase chunked plan: Phase 0 extracts 10 stubbed sub-lemmas + skeleton, phases 1-10 drift-repair one private lemma each, phase 11 zero-debt verification

memory_candidates.content: When a single monolithic Lean theorem's proof overflows agent context during drift-repair (lean_goal returns huge hypothesis contexts because a shared prologue accumulates many hypotheses before any case work), the fix is a faithful structural refactor: extract each `cases` leaf into an independently-stated `private lemma` taking only the hypotheses that case needs. This bounds each sub-lemma's lean_goal context to a small, inspectable size, enabling per-chunk drift-repair. Land the structure first with `by sorry` stubs (a green-but-scaffolded checkpoint), then strictly reduce the sorry count to zero one lemma per commit. Preserve the public signature byte-for-byte when it is depended on downstream. Clean extraction requires: no cross-case let/have bindings and `cases` (not `induction`).
